d: A man disappears after a duck hunting trip in Florida on his sixth wedding anniversary and is later found to have been murdered.
Terrorism is suspected when a woman's truck explodes outside the daycare center where she works.

After Tahereh Ghassemi disappears from the Louisiana home she shares with her adult son, detectives discover that she'd recently come into a great deal of money  the investigation reveals an astonishing plot with international implications.
When Susan Woods doesn't show up for work, she is soon discovered dead in her bathtub  as police search for answers, they find a trail of victims.
After an apparent home invasion in Minnesota leaves Heidi Firkus dead and her husband, Nick, hospitalized, detectives learn the young couple was facing financial troubles.
The disappearance of a 20-year-old honors student causes her family to fear the worst  decades later, the mystery is solved.
